1	import type { PaperclipPluginManifestV1 } from "@paperclipai/plugin-sdk";
2	
3	const PLUGIN_ID = "paperclip-file-browser-example";
4	const FILES_SIDEBAR_SLOT_ID = "files-link";
5	const FILES_TAB_SLOT_ID = "files-tab";
6	const COMMENT_FILE_LINKS_SLOT_ID = "comment-file-links";
7	const COMMENT_OPEN_FILES_SLOT_ID = "comment-open-files";
8	
9	const manifest: PaperclipPluginManifestV1 = {
10	  id: PLUGIN_ID,
11	  apiVersion: 1,
12	  version: "0.2.0",
13	  displayName: "File Browser (Example)",
14	  description: "Example plugin that adds a Files link under each project in the sidebar, a file browser + editor tab on the project detail page, and per-comment file link annotations with a context menu action to open referenced files.",
15	  author: "Paperclip",
16	  categories: ["workspace", "ui"],
17	  capabilities: [
18	    "ui.sidebar.register",
19	    "ui.detailTab.register",
20	    "ui.commentAnnotation.register",
21	    "ui.action.register",
22	    "projects.read",
23	    "project.workspaces.read",
24	    "issue.comments.read",
25	    "plugin.state.read",
26	  ],
27	  instanceConfigSchema: {
28	    type: "object",
29	    properties: {
30	      showFilesInSidebar: {
31	        type: "boolean",
32	        title: "Show Files in Sidebar",
33	        default: false,
34	        description: "Adds the Files link under each project in the sidebar.",
35	      },
36	      commentAnnotationMode: {
37	        type: "string",
38	        title: "Comment File Links",
39	        enum: ["annotation", "contextMenu", "both", "none"],
40	        default: "both",
41	        description: "Controls which comment extensions are active: 'annotation' shows file links below each comment, 'contextMenu' adds an \"Open in Files\" action to the comment menu, 'both' enables both, 'none' disables comment features.",
42	      },
43	    },
44	  },
45	  entrypoints: {
46	    worker: "./dist/worker.js",
47	    ui: "./dist/ui",
48	  },
49	  ui: {
50	    slots: [
51	      {
52	        type: "projectSidebarItem",
53	        id: FILES_SIDEBAR_SLOT_ID,
54	        displayName: "Files",
55	        exportName: "FilesLink",
56	        entityTypes: ["project"],
57	        order: 10,
58	      },
59	      {
60	        type: "detailTab",
61	        id: FILES_TAB_SLOT_ID,
62	        displayName: "Files",
63	        exportName: "FilesTab",
64	        entityTypes: ["project"],
65	        order: 10,
66	      },
67	      {
68	        type: "commentAnnotation",
69	        id: COMMENT_FILE_LINKS_SLOT_ID,
70	        displayName: "File Links",
71	        exportName: "CommentFileLinks",
72	        entityTypes: ["comment"],
73	      },
74	      {
75	        type: "commentContextMenuItem",
76	        id: COMMENT_OPEN_FILES_SLOT_ID,
77	        displayName: "Open in Files",
78	        exportName: "CommentOpenFiles",
79	        entityTypes: ["comment"],
80	      },
81	    ],
82	  },
83	};
84	
85	export default manifest;
86
